scope: One already-audited baseline test. This overrides its KEEP row in extras.json; it is not an additional audited test or a new declaration.

dispositionOverrides.name: TestExecOutputTailSurvivesADaemonSlowerThanTheDrainDeadline
dispositionOverrides.reason: Removes test-only drain callback and mutable timeout override. A real wire credit/stdin handshake and actual child exit establish pending/unread output; the actual application timeout runs while credit is withheld; exact remaining bytes and successful exit/close prove no truncation.

evidence.independentContract: packages/api/src/box-protocol.ts channel credit/backpressure and byte-stream ordering; AGENTS.md preserve streaming and process lifecycle. Child output already produced must be delivered before EOF/exit/close even if the daemon consumes slowly.
evidence.realRegression: A drain that counts time waiting for credit closes output prematurely, losing an unread tail and/or emitting EOF/exit/close before pending bytes reach the daemon.
evidence.independentOracle: Authored shell output: window−1 zero bytes, atomic xy marker, separate 4096 zero-byte tail. The test independently expects last credited x, pending y+4096 zeros, exact total byte count and exit 0/close.
evidence.stableSeam: Actual exec channel stdin/credit/data/EOF/exit/close frames and observed OS process exit. No outputPumps callback, state accessor or timeout override remains.
evidence.refactorResistance: Pump/helper/variable identifiers and scheduling strategy may change. Only public wire credit/output and actual process lifetime are observed. A real five-second hold exercises the deployed deadline rather than replacing it.
evidence.uniqueProtection: Only retained non-detached exec case guarantees both a credit-blocked write and unread output after child exit. Ring overflow/reattach, ordinary exec, and detached viewer tests protect different states.

credibleUnitFailureModes: Credit-wait time incorrectly consumes the read-drain budget.
Output is closed while unread bytes remain behind a credit-blocked write.
EOF/exit/close is emitted before pending output bytes.
dispositionOverrides.nonTestCallers: Go agent openExec and detached output pumps use the same private fixed read-drain constant. The removed callback had no production caller.
dispositionOverrides.validationCommand: cd apps/box-agent && GO=/usr/local/go/bin/go node scripts/go.mjs test -race -count=2 -run '^TestExecOutputTailSurvivesADaemonSlowerThanTheDrainDeadline$' -v ./internal/agent

productionChanges: Removed drainPausedHook declaration and callback branch.
Changed outputDrainAfterExit from test-mutable var to private const, keeping actual 2s value and drain behavior.
sixBarTradeoff: The earlier extras report statement that the hook was necessary is superseded. The stable external replacement costs a real 5s observation window, explicitly authorized by root, without Go 1.24 changes/new dependencies or timer injection.

completed.result: intentionally failed at 4.04s for premature eof on channel 1/stream 1, before pending output was delivered
completed.mutation: When waitFor timer expires, return false even while writing is blocked on daemon credit.

completed.command: SHA-256 comparison before/after isolated mutation run
completed.result: Both shared exec.go and exec_unix_test.go unchanged; shared files never mutated, so no restoration was needed.

validation.testRuns: Focused normal race regression passed twice; historical wall-time truncation mutant failed for the intended early EOF outcome. Root owns broader integration/package/full gates.
validation.mutationProof: Proved: the isolated wall-time drain mutant returned false when timer expired despite credit-blocked writing. This same retained test failed at 4.04s with premature wire eof ch1/stream 1. Shared source hashes match their pre-mutation values.

performance.note: No comparable pre-rewrite individual timing exists; these prove the deliberately retained real 5s boundary and normal-repeat consistency, not a suite speedup.
